items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I worked with Mud Carrier after Eli after Zutty left.

ctx.x: The part that broke him last.

That's correct. I never heard of that. That's pretty good. So you worked with Mud after Zutty left huh? I worked with Mud Carrier after Eli after Zutty left. And then who else was in the band? I can't remember now. Was it a big band? Was Zutty considered a good drummer then? Fine drummer. Correct. Played all the shows up at the Lyric Theater. Professor Robichaud's band.
Yeah, Zutty was a fine drummer. I heard him last summer and it was something else to see a man like that you know. Yeah.
